f5.title: Compare rotations
f5.dateHint: The first crop can start any day in this range.
f5.suggestHint: Leave the selection empty to search the catalog for options. Choosing a crop removes it from the opposite list.
f5.rotationHint: Add up to six crops in order. Move them with the buttons.
f5.inferRotation: Without a declared cycle, the server will try to infer your rotation from history.
f5.noRotation: I do not follow a set rotation
f5.historyQuestion: Is this all the crops you grew during the recorded period?
f5.unknownEffect: Nothing reported. The comparison will explain this gap.
f5.savedInputs: Saved field information, included in this comparison.
f5.planOnly: This measurement stays in the draft and plan. The field profile cannot store it.
f5.priorityMeaning: Set each priority from zero to five, with at least one above zero.
f5.meaning.climate: Limit heat, frost and drought damage.
f5.incomeGap: Income data is limited: see the gaps in your results.
f5.incomeUntouched: Income priority is untouched and will be omitted.
f5.incomeIncluded: Your income priority will be included.
f5.contextMeaning: These answers shape explanations. Ranking uses the priorities above.
f5.reviewSentence: We will try to compare your rotation with at least two alternatives over {years} years, with first sowing between {start} and {end}.
f5.reviewCaveat: Options depend on evidence and your constraints.
f5.valid: The request meets the required format.
f5.invalid: Correct the listed items before sending.
f5.answerHistory: Say whether your history is complete or partial.
f5.storageUnavailable: Storage unavailable: keep this page open to retain the draft.
f5.idempotencyConflict: This request was already sent with different details. Sending again will use a new key.
f5.validation.value: Check this value and its stated limits.
f5.intakeRange: The server accepts first sowing between today and the next 366 days.
f5.intakeFuture: Observations must be dated today or earlier.
f5.historyLimit: This field has more history than one comparison accepts. The history stays saved; this request cannot be sent yet.
f5.catalogLoading: Loading the crop catalog. You can edit dates while it loads.
